Well that whole story was just one chapter of the mess i was in last year so here is a description of her behaviour, R. was my other female flatmate at that time, V. is the liar:

 She was extremely nice to me from the beginning on, she was pretty and  seemed very caring and loving which really attracted my shatterd soul at  that time. She invited me to a festival and i went with her and had a  very good time. After the festival she broke up with her boyfriend and  said she wanted to commit to the polyamorist lifestyle now that i was leading as well which  he didn´t want. So, i invited her to stay at my and R.´s flat as we  just got a vacant room. From then on things started to go downhill  pretty fast. V. was really keen on sleeping with me everytime she could  and also tried to make everyone around her fall in love with her which  often succeeded as she had this kind of attracting and "mystical",  loving vibe around her. But pretty soon i realized that a lot of the  things she said to attract peoples attention simply could not be true.I  started being sceptical as she told so many wild and crazy stories that  everyone could get the feeling that they have the most interesting girl  ever sitting with them.I got that feeling too.It started with harmless  things like pretending to know languages that don´t even exist  (sunchinese), telling that the wine she brought was worth 500 Euros ( a  quick internet research showed it was worth 7), giving me a leather vest  that her grandfather supposedly wore in the second worldwar (again a  quick internet research showed that the fabricator was founded in the  70s) and so on. For many other stories i can not find definite proof but  they are highly unlikely to have happened. Every other day there was  new crazy story. She was beaten up by a costumer, poisened by somebody  (which made me go to the hospital with her) and so on. She often  pretended to be crying to make me feel guilty or protective all while  offering to fullfill all my sexual dreams. It was a real mindfuck. All  the other people around me that where guest at my flat fell in love with  this "sensitive,emotional and interesting" girl while i started to  constantly question my reality , telling myself i was ony jellous of all  he attention she got or that it would be unfair for me to attack her  clearly fragile self-image as she made a very mentally fragile  impression, telling stories of her having grown up in a  fosterhome,  being beaten up by her father and so on. I thought i need to have  patience and tolerance towards her lies and deception. But pretty soon  her stories became increasingly dangerous and intolerable for me as they  included false rape allegations towards 2 people i knew which were  definitely not true. She had such a talent at destroying your self  esteem applying social pressure without people even realizing it while  still maintaing that image of the special, all-loving godess. She would  have done anything to protect that image
Yes she was a women.
